dogecoin.text: @Tsekorsa We added Dogecoin due to strong customer demand & we'll be adding more coins in the coming months.
@AubieStoned As we share on the post, it is currently not possible to transfer Dogecoin from the platform to the eToro Money Wallet - the coin is currently not offered on the wallet.

@teh_gamist As a broker, eToro offers its users a choice of assets to invest in if they wish to. 

Dogecoin has a strong following and we saw strong customer demand to offer it.
@reece_parke We added Dogecoin due to strong customer demand - and we are taking our customer's requests into consideration. We will be adding more coins in the coming months.
@Lynchburg_T eToro has been offering access to the crypto market for retail clients since 2013. Dogecoin was added due to strong customer demand & we'll be adding more coins in the coming months.

@dxbjohn961 Dogecoin is an open source peer-to-peer cryptoasset which at the time of the listing on eToro is in the top 10 cryptoassets in the world in terms of market capitalization, which indicates that it is highly adopted by users.

@Dogecoin_boo We are working to ensure that we continue to provide the very best crypto offering to our clients. However, we cannot give an ETA as to when we will provide support for Doge on the eToro Wallet but if there is any change, we'll make sure to share information with our customers.
